Multiple work sites. One software.

Manage your employees’ breath alcohol data from multiple sites all in one place with Andalink. Compatible with Andatech Soberlive FRX and Prodigy 3.

settings.heading: Maintain multiple alcohol-free work sites with ease.

settings.text: Track your employees’ breath alcohol data wherever they are located.

settings.heading: Ready-to-analyse data via dashboard
settings.text: Breath alcohol data from multiple breathalysers are aggregated and displayed in charts. Reports in CSV format available.

settings.heading: Instant breath alcohol data collection
settings.text: Employees are identified through facial recognition and their breath alcohol data is matched to their profiles in real time.

settings.heading: Centralised & secure database
settings.text: Breath alcohol data is stored in cloud and is accessible remotely. No manual data entry. No missing data.

settings.heading: Dedicated account manager
settings.text: IT and calibration management support are provided for reliable breath alcohol data management.

settings.heading: Customised notifications & alerts
settings.text: Managers can be notified through email when a breath alcohol test exceeds the set limit.

settings.heading: Employees’ breath alcohol data at your fingertips.

settings.text:
From devices to cloud-based software. No messy database. No hassle in execution.

  2. Receive the breathalysers within 5 business days after payment.
  3. Have your Andalink account set up and synced with all your breathalysers.
  4. Complete training for using Andalink and breathalyers.
